layer.answer_rule: P-1 and every real decode query including EOS prediction blocked from original Image Keys at all 32 layers in every frontier condition.
layer.relay_rule: All original nonimage queries strictly after final image token and before P-1. R->Image open only at the explicit kept layers.
layer.hard_mask_implementation: Call frozen visual_write_window.engine.apply_mask at each layer, selecting historical All-Writer on kept layers and No-Writer elsewhere. No historical source edits or output ablation.
layer.probability_validation: Actual eager post-softmax forbidden maximum exactly zero in every layer/forward; existing row-sum bound 0.002; BOS/Self and non-target native mask retained.

quality_bounds.rule: Candidate iff observed accuracy difference versus All-Writer is at least bound. Point-estimate screen only, not non-inferiority; CI crossing zero proves nothing.

layer.frontier: Point Pareto frontier across ten conditions using kept-layer count and full-answer accuracy. Ties at identical count and accuracy retained; uncertainty not removed. Native Full excluded.

native_full_reference.reason: Native answer queries can read image keys; All-Writer cannot.

smoke.strict: HF/Native/all six no-ops match all effective logits by torch.equal with logits_to_keep=1. Old/new engines match all effective baseline logits; saved baseline first vectors and tokens exact.

manifest_note.action: Preserve exact bytes from requested repair commit; transcription discrepancy recorded

layer.stop: No extra search, joint token ablation, router, kernel, new model or dataset.

semantic.answer_rule: P-1 and every real decode query (including EOS prediction) blocked from original image keys at all 32 layers in all ten conditions
semantic.relay_rule: Only selected original R query rows can read original image keys, at every layer; all non-image sources and all other computations native

lexical_rule.method: Frozen closed functional stoplist; all remaining question whole words are core candidates, including wh, relations, logical operators, numbers and referential anchors
lexical_rule.budget: Largest attainable core-group budget compatible with exact whole-word Question-Last-k and R-Last-k; left-to-right semantic subset tie break
lexical_rule.drop_semantic: Complement of the final frozen Semantic-k set, not of every unselected lexical candidate; necessary for unambiguous same-set necessity test
lexical_rule.scaffold: Left-to-right noncore groups, largest attainable budget no larger than k; report deficits without deleting questions
lexical_rule.random: Seeded random permutation of whole R groups followed by first feasible exact-k subset DP, not uniform over independent subwords
lexical_rule.random_key: seed plus question text only, never image, gold or model output

inference.cluster: Image SHA256, paired across all conditions
inference.random_average: Per-question arithmetic mean of three seed correctness indicators, not 720 independent samples
inference.adjusted_CI: Also Bonferroni over the seven declared primary contrasts
inference.quality_plot_strata: Input-only k ranges: 1-6, 7-10, >=11; no new budget policies or generations

semantic.interpretation: Writer denotes permission to directly read image keys, not unique information storage or actual speedup
semantic.stop: No more layers, activation patching, router, training or kernel experiments

all.answer_rule: Every condition: P-1 and every real decode query, including EOS prediction, cannot read original image keys at all 32 layers.
all.relay_rule: R = every original nonvisual query after final image token and strictly before P-1. Only frozen writer layers allow R->original image keys.
all.mask: Clone native causal additive mask; only legal selected query->original 576 image key entries become -inf. No o_proj ablation. Other queries, keys, MLP, residual, RoPE and KV native.
all.actual_probabilities: Observe actual eager returned post-softmax matrices in each layer and real forward; forbidden max exactly zero; existing ROW_ATOL=0.002. No tolerance relaxed.

swap.acceptance: Same text IDs, different image SHA/gold. Complete generated tokens and every effective logits vector must be torch.equal; maximum difference zero. Failure stops main collection.

smoke.Full_Noop_HF: Same logits_to_keep=1 shape, strict torch.equal on all effective logits

statistics.descriptive: Each condition vs All-Writer and vs No-Writer; six tasks; no confirmatory multiplicity, equivalence or NI claim

manifest_note.action: Preserve exact bytes from requested repair commit; transcription discrepancy recorded

all.stop: No patching, new model, router, kernel, KV pruning or extra conditions
